entities.name: UE satellite E-UTRAN access
entities.description: Condition where UE operates via satellite E-UTRAN access in WB-S1 mode. Specifies special NAS timer value handling for this access type.

entities.name: NAS timer for WB-S1/CE mode
entities.description: Applicable NAS timer values indicated in tables 10.2.1 and 10.3.1 for WB-S1/CE mode. Used by UE when accessing via satellite E-UTRAN.

entities.name: MME NAS timer for WB-S1/CE mode
entities.description: Applicable NAS timer values indicated in tables 10.2.2 and 10.3.2 for WB-S1/CE mode. Used by MME when performing NAS signalling with UE via satellite E-UTRAN access.

entities.name: NAS procedure
entities.description: Generic NAS procedure during which NAS timer values are calculated at start and remain unchanged until completion, restart, or abortion.

entities.name: MME supporting WB-S1 mode
entities.description: Condition where MME supports WB-S1 mode and performs NAS signalling with UE via satellite E-UTRAN access.

entities.name: Enhanced coverage indication restriction
entities.description: Property stating that enhanced coverage indication from network is not considered when determining applicable NAS timers for satellite E-UTRAN access.
